title: Agent operator contract Figure
description: One measured or estimated figure with its unit and basis (spec section 7.3). value is null exactly when basis is unavailable or not_applicable.

value.description: The figure value; null exactly when basis is unavailable or not_applicable, otherwise a number. Never zero as a stand-in for unknown.

unit.description: tokens, usd, seconds, count or ratio (0 to 1).

basis.description: How the value was produced; unavailable and not_applicable require a null value.

reason.description: Optional human text, e.g. why a figure is unavailable.
